sentences.text: On the matter being taken up, Mr. Alok Kumar Kushwaha, learned counsel for the revisionist submits that during pendency of this criminal revision before this Court, the revisionist/Sunil Gupta has been acquitted by the trial Court, therefore, cause of filing the instant criminal revision has lost its efficacy.
Learned A.G.A. representing the State does not dispute the aforesaid fact.
